[EN] The suspicious men in Cutthroat Harbor have disguised themselves as sailors. Moreover, these suspicious sailors seem to take a real interest in who comes and goes in Cutthroat Harbor. They might be watching for someone.

—KiniasPut the report away.
[ES] Los hombres sospechosos en Cutthroat Harbor se han disfrazado de marineros. Además, estos marineros sospechosos parecen tener un interés real en quién entra y sale de Cutthroat Harbor. Podrían estar vigilando a alguien.

—KiniasPut the report away.
